source_section: 5.4 交付结构; 6 Golden/no-change 对照; 7 多模型验证; 8.2 区分度准入
license: Original code and fixtures authored for this evaluation. No upstream source file is copied into this package. The behaviour contract comes from the documented Windows access-token model: a token carries a TOKEN_PRIVILEGES array whose entries pair a LUID with an attributes DWORD, SE_PRIVILEGE_ENABLED is the bit that switches a held privilege on, and AdjustTokenPrivileges is the only supported way to change it (MSDN: TOKEN_PRIVILEGES, AdjustTokenPrivileges, LookupPrivilegeValue).
lineage: Documented Windows token semantics (privileges are held per token and carry an enabled bit that is a separate dimension) -> workspace module wtoken frozen in the naive shape that reads the human-facing privilege table printed by a system tool and reports every row as available -> the Windows held-versus-enabled contract expressed as acceptance criteria A-G -> evaluator-side independent measurement: the grader opens the process token with OpenProcessToken, reads TokenPrivileges with GetTokenInformation, cross-checks names and LUIDs with LookupPrivilegeValue/LookupPrivilegeName, drives AdjustTokenPrivileges through the candidate and re-reads the attribute bits itself, and compares elevation and integrity against TokenElevation and TokenIntegrityLevel -> local oracle/no-change differential calibration -> container control runs on the pinned Windows Server Core image.
pollution_risk: Low. The subject is the Windows process token privilege model reached through OpenProcessToken / GetTokenInformation(TokenPrivileges) / LookupPrivilegeValue / LookupPrivilegeName / AdjustTokenPrivileges plus TokenElevation and TokenIntegrityLevel. A dedup sweep over the 48-question buyer checklist, the batch task index and every delivered package found the neighbouring families already occupied - registry notifications (002.1), ACL/DACL/SDDL (002.2, 002.3, 006, 011, 019, 036), file identity and hard links (002.2, 010, 027, 032, 037), file sharing and locks (003, 016, 041), reparse points and junctions (007, 017), Job Objects (008), named events and mutexes (018, 020, 023), named pipes (021, 022), alternate data streams (007, 011, 019, 024), DPAPI (026, 030), file attributes and timestamps (031, 033), ReadDirectoryChanges and FileSystemWatcher (028, 042), environment variables (043) and PATHEXT/process argument handling (012, 014, 034, 038, 040) - while the token-privilege family returned no hit at all.
authorization: No external repository is vendored. The only third-party artefacts are the pinned Microsoft Windows Server Core base image, the PSF-licensed Python 3.12.9 embeddable distribution, MinGit and the offline wheelhouse already used by the other tasks in this batch. No network access is required to build or grade the task.
